title: Fits Under Kitchen Cabinets, But Releases Steam While Brewing
text:
Fits Under Kitchen Cabinets, But Releases Steam While Brewing. This HAMILTON BEACH 12 CUP COMPACT PROGRAMMABLE COFFEE MAKER (Black with Stainless Steel Accents (46200)) really is compact--it fits under my kitchen cabinets with room to spare. However, it’s a good idea to pull it out from under the kitchen cabinets when you’re actually brewing coffee, because steam escapes from the top--especially if the coffee maker is in need of cleaning.

It makes good coffee, so I’m happy enough with it. I don’t use the programming feature--which other reviewers say will fail after a few months because steam gets into the display--so the coffee maker suits my needs. I truly hated a fancy Ninja coffee maker that was too tall to fit under my kitchen cabinets, because it hogged so much counter space.

The best coffeemaker that I’ve ever owned is this [[ASIN:B0844DSDBH Hamilton Beach Frontfill Deluxe Coffee Maker]], which fits under my kitchen cabinets, does NOT release steam while coffee is brewing, and is extremely easy to fill. If you can find one of these, it’s the one you should buy.

Other reviewers have complained about the inability to get replacement carafes for the Hamilton Beach coffee makers. This is true of virtually any brand of coffee maker. If you need a replacement carafe, you should ONLY buy a carafe that says it fits the particular brand and model number. The carafe lids on different models of the same brand have slightly different dome heights or configurations, so that the carafes are NOT interchangeable from model to model.

I’m okay with the carafe thing, as long as the coffee maker isn’t very expensive to begin with. It makes sense to simply buy a new coffee maker if you break the carafe, because the inexpensive models only last 2-3 years anyway.

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach 12 Cup Compact Programmable Drip Coffee Maker with No-Drip Burosilicate Glass Carafe, 2-Hour Auto Shutoff, Space-Saving Design, Black with Stainless Steel Accents (46200)
features: COMPACT, SPACE-SAVING DESIGN FITS UNDER CABINETS — The programmable coffee maker's compact design easily fits under kitchen cabinets and is perfect for smaller kitchens, or for optimizing countertop space in any kitchen.

NO-DRIP 12 CUP BOROSILICATE GLASS CARAFE — The no-drip design of the 12 cup carafe on the drip coffee maker eliminates mess. The carafe holds plenty of coffee for serving a large family or group. It's made of borosilicate glass to be more durable.

TOP-MOUNTED DIGITAL CONTROLS WITH EASY-TOUCH PROGRAMMING — Controls are at the top so they're easier to see. They're also simple to use with Easy-Touch programming. Easily program the coffee maker up to 24 hours ahead for wake-up ready coffee.
2-HOUR AUTOMATIC SHUTOFF: The Hamilton Beach coffee maker automatically turns off after 2 hours for peace of mind.
SELECT-A-BREW BREW-STRENGTH SELECTOR TO CUSTOMIZE BREWING STRENGTH: With this small coffee maker, you can select your coffee's brew strength to match your preference or mood, regular or bold.
